findings.title: Fold-boundary freeze deferred past D2; exact UTC boundary timestamps required by the binding A2/A4 fold rule are absent from the plan
findings.evidence: PLAN section 4 F4: 'EXACT UTC fold boundaries frozen at S BEFORE any D2 diagnostic' - but phase S (section 9: 'selection + exact arm/data/fold/config hash freeze') follows D2 in the execution order, making F4 internally contradictory. A2 dossier (clock): boundaries 'frozen pre-D1 in the cycle plan'. A4 axis-4 binding_fold_rule_text: 'boundaries are exact UTC timestamps frozen in the cycle plan before any D1 computation' (365/4 = 91.25 days, so approximate bounds are insufficient). The plan nowhere states the four boundary timestamps. D2's R2 fold-positivity and >= 4-decisions/fold kill depend on the boundaries; choosing them after any D2 diagnostic is a gerrymandering surface on a kill rule.
findings.remediation: Freeze the exact UTC fold boundary timestamps in the plan (or a committed fold-contract artifact under research/control/crypto_ng4_run/) before D1; rewrite F4 to require pre-D1 in-plan freeze; M0 fixture (a) must test assignment against the frozen timestamps.

findings.title: Historical-leg RV24 kill-control estimand undefined; A4 axis-8 binding notes unadopted (SOL constants; declared approximation)
findings.evidence: PLAN section 6 VOL-SHOCK uses 'RV24 STRESS/VOLATILITY_EVENT states (labels from section 7 regime definition)', but section 7 defines RV24 on 'the cross-venue median mid' (Coinbase/Kraken/Deribit) - a series that does not exist for the HISTORICAL D2 run on the S4 panels. A4 axis-8 binding notes: (a) SOL has NO frozen RV constants - freeze SOL constants from the SOL panel (P33.3/P66.7/P90) before D1 or declare SOL unpartitioned ('today it is undefined'); (b) the Binance-percentile -> cross-venue-mid estimand transfer must be 'recorded as a declared approximation, not silently assumed'. The plan adopts neither note; as written the historical VOL-SHOCK control pointer is broken and the SOL-pair control labels are undefined - a kill-control ambiguity.
findings.remediation: One plan sentence: historical D2 RV24/VOLATILITY_EVENT labels are computed panel-natively from S4 last_price with the same frozen percentile constants, recorded as the declared approximation per A4 axis-8(b); SOL constants frozen from the SOL panel before D1, or SOL declared unpartitioned with the SOL-pair VOL-SHOCK control NOT_RUN fail-closed.

findings.title: Weekend floor carries the conflated '>= 86 valid weekend bars' guarantee that A4 axis-7 explicitly rejected
findings.evidence: PLAN section 7: 'each 15-day fold >= 4 weekend days = >= 86 valid weekend bars'. Recomputation: 4 weekend days = 96 raw H1 bars; 86 = 96 x 0.9 presumes 90% validity WITHIN weekend bars, which fold-global 90% does not guarantee (A4 axis 7: 'the binding guarantee is the calendar 96 raw bars with >= 4-cell robustness, not the 86 figure'). No floor-PASS path opens - the operative weekend floor is >= 4 valid cells/fold, which the calendar guarantees with 21.5x margin - but the plan asserts an unsound '=' and the M0 floor verifier (section 3 fixture c) must not encode the 86 figure as a guaranteed derivation.
findings.remediation: Adopt A4 axis-7 wording in section 7; the floor verifier asserts >= 4 valid weekend cells/fold and the >= 16 weekend days per 60-day calendar guarantee, never the 86 figure.

findings.title: Scored-cell granularity ambiguous against the 3-cell budget - trial-accounting undercount surface
